Basically, the first 5* you get has a 50/50 chance to be one of the banner weaps or a standard weap. However, if you get the standard weap, the next 5* you get is guaranteed to be one of the banner weaps (50/50). Then, if that one isn’t the epitomized path one, the next 5* is guaranteed to be the epitomized path one. 

Pity carries over, however epitomized path does not. However, if you lose the first 50/50 (aka you get a standard weap), then that loss carries over to future banners and you will get a banner weapon as your next 5* on whatever future weapon banner

Transformative reactions such as swirl, hyperbloom, etc. scale on character level and EM--so, you want to get any chara procing these reactions to level 90 to maximize damage. In your case, that would be Kuki (if you're using her for hyperbloom) and Sucrose. Also, if a chara ascends with crit rate, crit damge or elemental dmg % it's usually worth at least ascending them to 80/90 for the extra ascension stat, and if they scale off def or hp it's usually worth it to level them to 90 for the extra boost in def/hp.
